svg.aria-label: Five radar charts, one per upscaler, each with ten spokes; on every spoke the best of the five reaches the outer ring and the others reach in proportion to it, so a larger shape is better and a dent is a weakness. The lossy DLL comes first, and its shape is the dashed outline in the other four. Still picture and moving background, mean: accuracy (dB): FSR 4.1.1 46.80 dB, Lossy 46.62 dB, FSR 3.1 43.95 dB, HelixSR 44.45 dB, XeSS 44.92 dB. Thin railing in motion: accuracy (dB): FSR 4.1.1 41.82 dB, Lossy 41.34 dB, FSR 3.1 38.36 dB, HelixSR 40.12 dB, XeSS 40.86 dB. Areas a moving object has just uncovered, mean of a panning and a still camera: accuracy (dB): FSR 4.1.1 33.55 dB, Lossy 33.84 dB, FSR 3.1 29.59 dB, HelixSR 28.44 dB, XeSS 30.87 dB. Old image beside a moving object, mean of seven scenes: error (of 255): FSR 4.1.1 1.92, Lossy 2.32, FSR 3.1 3.20, HelixSR 3.45, XeSS 4.84. Thin bars fixed on screen in front of a panning background, mean of four pans: error where their old image lands (of 255): FSR 4.1.1 0.82, Lossy 0.91, FSR 3.1 1.04, HelixSR 2.92, XeSS 3.85. Tiny fast sparks: share of their brightness shown (%): FSR 4.1.1 83%, Lossy 74%, FSR 3.1 40%, HelixSR 79%, XeSS 50%. Leaves swaying without motion vectors, mean of three sway speeds: error (of 255): FSR 4.1.1 11.0, Lossy 14.5, FSR 3.1 16.7, HelixSR 14.3, XeSS 14.3. Still picture: change per frame (of 255): FSR 4.1.1 0.037, Lossy 0.024, FSR 3.1 0.014, HelixSR 0.020, XeSS 0.084. Thin wire under a slow pan: how far its brightness is from the true one (of 255): FSR 4.1.1 10.5, Lossy 34.0, FSR 3.1 10.8, HelixSR 23.9, XeSS 21.0. Time per upscale call, mean of 1080p, 1440p and 4K output (ms): FSR 4.1.1 2.68 ms, Lossy 1.30 ms, FSR 3.1 0.70 ms, HelixSR 1.24 ms, XeSS 2.90 ms.
svg.text: The shape of each upscaler: ten measures
On every spoke the best of the five reaches the outer ring. Bigger is better; a dent is a weakness. Dashed: the lossy DLL.
left beside moving objects, seven scenes
old image of thin things fixed on screen
a thin wire in a pan: brightness off the true one
time per call, mean of three output sizes
A spoke at half length: twice the error (or the change per frame, or the time) of the best of the five; for sparks, half as much shown.
Test rig, 4K output, one card, single runs. This project's exact DLL has FSR 4.1.1's shape with a longer speed spoke (1.83 ms against 2.68).
